modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: What fits in the cabin depends on the ticket type; Economy Superlight includes only a small bag.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Carry-on bag up to 55 x 40 x 23 cm (21.7 x 15.7 x 9.1 in).

personal_item.value: Small bag up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm (15.7 x 11.8 x 5.9 in).

carryon_weight.value: Maximum combined weight of carry-on bag and small bag: 8 kg or 12 kg (17.6 / 26.5 lb) depending on ticket type; the 12 kg limit is listed for Business.
carryon_weight.notes: The page gives the limit as '8/12 kg' and lists 12 kg against Business Flex.

superlight.value: Economy Superlight does not include a carry-on bag; it can be bought as an extra. Finnair Plus Silver, Gold, Platinum and Platinum Lumo members get one complimentary carry-on bag on European flights with a Superlight ticket.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Allowances vary by ticket type and route. Light and Superlight tickets include no checked bag.

piece_weight_economy.value: Economy Classic and Flex: 1 piece of 23 kg on most routes; 2 pieces of 23 kg each between Japan and Europe. Economy Light and Superlight: 0 checked bags.
piece_weight_economy.notes: Allowance for Japan flights depends on the departure/destination country and ticket options.

piece_weight_premium_economy.value: Premium Economy Classic and Flex: 2 pieces of 23 kg each between Japan or North America and Europe; 1 piece of 23 kg to/from Asia and the Middle East. Premium Economy Light: 0 checked bags.

piece_weight_business.value: Business Classic and Flex: 3 pieces of 32 kg each between Japan and Europe; 2 pieces of 32 kg each to/from Asia, the Middle East and North America; 1 piece of 23 kg on other routes. Business Light: 0 checked bags.

size.value: Each bag up to 90 cm x 75 cm x 45 cm (35 in x 30 in x 18 in). Maximum weight 23 kg (50 lb) in Economy and Premium Economy; in Business, 23 kg on short-haul and 32 kg (70 lb) on long-haul flights.
